purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Import Depot Activity Empty Return Pre Advice details.
features: This function allows the user to generate Empty Return Pre Advice right fax.
Empty Return Location cannot be null.

events.description: Generates the Empty Return Pre Advice for the selected BL records.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more BL records using the check boxes, clicks the ☰ icon at Voyage level in Depot Activity and selects "Empty Return Pre-Advise".
